user_authority: User approves shared Hair/Upper/Lower plus GT-Face-box local IoU on both CIHP and CCTV; no model inference
prediction_contract: Original-grid integer per-person planes/extents/scores; preserve native ownership. Recognized OTHER includes Dress/Apparel. Unknown or prediction255 is contract failure. No prediction edited from GT.

matching.objective: maximum cardinality, then sum mask IoU, geometry-canonical deterministic ties; identical geometry fallback and ambiguity reported

GT.CIHP: Frozen native20+Human IDs; source255 VOID, semantic owner unknown (category>0 human0) excluded from semantic tasks; localization extent=(human==pid)&source valid
GT.CCTV: User-accepted original-grid derived person/part masks, 127 reference persons. All positive part masks used, no prior 61/21/112/96 exclusions imported. Shared semantic VOID=GT person-overlap OR cross-target semantic overlap. No global-scene negatives inferred. Missing target polygon is not a negative/absent test.
GT.eligibility: One union mask per GT person+target; eligible iff positive support in shared semantic-valid domain. Count parts before/after shared VOID.
GT.person_extent_note: CCTV reference quality accepted by user; not independent expert gold; this run does not change GT geometry to improve detector matching

C3.task: Positive GT-person-part overlap for Hair/Upper/Lower on original-grid semantic-valid domain; other pixels in the matched person plane remain negative for this owner-specific part task
C3.aggregation: mean IoU across eligible GT person-parts within each target, then equal mean of three target means
C3.name: mIoU3_part_mean
C3.not_equivalent_to: Frozen global C3 or whole-scene semantic mIoU
C3.missed_GT_person: GT part remains in denominator with IoU0
C3.unmatched_predictions: Not directly penalized in part mean; report GT-reference localization FP/F1 separately

Face_local.box: Tight axis-aligned bbox of raw GT Face mask BEFORE shared VOID; max x/y plus1 exclusive; no margin
Face_local.domain: bbox AND same GT-only semantic-valid mask for every model
Face_local.prediction: CIHP Face13, or Sapiens Face_Neck3+24..28, using unchanged common projection
Face_local.counts: TP=(G&P&D), FP=(~G&P&D), FN=(G&~P&D); outside D ignored, never intersect prediction with GT shape
Face_local.aggregation: Mean IoU across all eligible GT-person Face masks; unmatched GT person contributes0
Face_local.not_claimed: Anatomical face-only equivalence, face detection without GT boxes, or penalty for overprediction outside GT box
Face_local.CCTV_previous_Neck_ignore: Not imported. No model-specific Neck exclusion; native predictions preserved.

reporting.comparison_unit: Pretrained checkpoint + frozen YOLO-controlled application configuration
reporting.timing: New CPU scoring wall time is not model inference speed; no latency/FPS/VRAM ranking

completeness: STRICT_COMPLETE exact expected image IDs separately for each dataset/checkpoint; primary null on missing/duplicate/invalid/errors
execution: CPU streaming, immutable source bindings, single writer lock, SQLite unique keys+FULL sync, atomic per-image transactions, explicit fingerprint-checked resume. No inference/training/OOM retries/fallback.
